lines.trans: The new felt bushing is dry and the brass pin sits tight, Teacher Song.
Your hands are as steady as a watchmaker's, Chen. May I try the key?
Go right ahead—gently first, then full weight.

words.gloss: feel free to; go right ahead

lines.trans: Listen... D! Clear, round, and zero rattle in the wood!
Sounds a tiny bit flat next to the note above it, doesn't it?
You have a good ear, Chen! Turn the steel tuning wrench a hair to the right.
Right here... tell me when to stop.
Right... there! Hold it! Play a warm G-major chord with me—listen!
Look at that—this old walnut box fills the whole glass room!
Wait until you hear Manager Zhou's aunt's finished waltz tomorrow afternoon, Chen.
Let me screw the front panel back on and polish the brass pedals.
Thank you, Chen. After thirty quiet years, this piano has its voice back.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì sī sī. Reduplicated diminutive quantity phrase 一 ('one') + 丝丝 ('fine silk thread / hair's breadth'); yī shifts to yì before 1st-tone sī.

examples.text: 把钢调音扳手往右轻轻拧一丝丝，音准就刚刚好了。
examples.trans: Turn the steel tuning wrench just a tiny hair to the right and the pitch is spot on.

examples.text: 柠檬挞里加了一丝丝盐，反而让甜味显得更清爽。
examples.trans: Adding a tiny fraction of salt to the lemon tart makes the sweetness taste even brighter.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí yàng. Pairs with 跟/和 in 跟…一样 ('the same as…').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 哎呀！我跑得太急，包装看着都一样！
examples.trans: Oh no! I was running in such a rush that the wrappers all looked alike!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎn. Before a noun, means 'a little bit of' (一点糖); after an adjective, 'a bit more' (快一点).

examples.text: 只有一点点牛奶、两个鸡蛋，一点黄油都没有！
examples.trans: Only a tiny bit of milk, two eggs, and no butter at all!

examples.text: 太好了！请加牛奶和一点糖。
examples.trans: Wonderful! With milk and a little sugar, please.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎnr. Erhua quantifier/adverb 一 ('one') + 点儿 ('little bit'); used after adjectives (低一点儿 'a tiny bit flat') or before 也不/都没 ('not at all').

examples.text: 那根高音钢丝听起来还稍微低一点儿，再调一下吧。
examples.trans: That treble steel string still sounds a tiny bit flat; let's tune it a touch more.

examples.text: 水性的花园油漆气味很小，走廊里一点儿也不呛人。
examples.trans: Water-based garden paint has very little odour and isn't pungent in the hallway at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì qǐ. Placed right before the verb to mean 'together' (一起吃晚饭 'have dinner together').

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

examples.text: 等等，让我把平板屏幕和纸本子放一起看。
examples.trans: Wait—let me look at the tablet screen and the paper ledger side by side.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān shí. Cardinal number thirty ('three tens'); pairs directly with measure words like 三十年 ('thirty years').

examples.text: 这棵老树在院子里长了三十年。
examples.trans: This old tree has grown in the courtyard for thirty years.

examples.text: 从客栈走到地铁站只要三十分钟。
examples.trans: Walking from the inn to the metro station takes only thirty minutes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng mian. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 最上面 ('the very top').

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

examples.text: 上面有名字或者电话号码吗？
examples.trans: Is there a name or a phone number on it?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Friendly farewell xiàcì jiàn.

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，下次见！
examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!

examples.text: 我们下次见！
examples.trans: See you next time!

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liàng. Describes bright light or a surface polished clean (擦亮 'polish bright').

examples.text: 隔壁的小洗手间呢？灯亮吗？
examples.trans: What about the small bathroom next door? Does the light work?

examples.text: 火苗亮了——稳稳的蓝火，正合适。
examples.trans: The flame is lit—steady blue fire, right as it should be.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dī. Describes low height, volume, or pitch (声音很低 'voice is low').

examples.text: 先生，到了。小心碰头，这根木房梁比较低。
examples.trans: Here we are, sir. Mind your head—this wooden beam is fairly low.

examples.text: 她说话的声音很低。
examples.trans: Her speaking voice is very soft and low.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tíng. Used for vehicles pulling up, rain stopping, or pausing an action.

examples.text: 别动，你们俩。听到路边汽车停下的声音了吗？
examples.trans: Hold still, both of you. Hear that car engine stopping at the curb?

examples.text: 一辆黄色出租车刚停在铁大门外头！
examples.trans: A yellow taxi just pulled up outside the iron gate!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiàng. Introduces a likeness or example ('look like, be like').

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 他长得真像他哥哥。
examples.trans: He really looks like his older brother.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. Marks a next step in sequence (先提再推) or a future repetition (再见 'see you again').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiě. Used for writing characters, notes, letters, or reviews.

examples.text: 到星期五？没写名字，也没签名！
examples.trans: Until Friday? No name written, and no signature either!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qián. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个前面 ('a front side').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì qi. Combines 力 ('force/strength') + neutral-tone 气 ('energy').

examples.text: 搬这张厚木桌需要不少力气。
examples.trans: Moving this thick wooden table takes quite a bit of strength.

examples.text: 开旧锁要靠巧劲，光用力气可不行。
examples.trans: Opening an old lock takes knack; sheer muscle alone won't do.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shí zú. Literally 十 ('ten out of ten') + 足 ('sufficient/complete'); often follows nouns such as 中气十足 ('full of resonance'), 信心十足 (' brimming with confidence').

examples.text: 修好轴销以后，中央瑞音听起来清脆又有劲，中气十足！
examples.trans: Now that the center pin is fixed, middle D sounds crisp, strong, and full of resonance!

examples.text: 喝过热茶以后，大家干活都精神十足。
examples.trans: After a cup of hot tea, everyone worked with full energy.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ké yǐ. Polite modal verb for asking or granting permission (可以吗？ 'Is that alright?').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 阁楼书房？我可以先上去看看吗？
examples.trans: An attic study? May I go up and see it first?

meanings.note: Classifier/noun tái ('stage; classifier for equipment/TVs').

examples.text: 演播室的设备一人盯一台。
examples.trans: Watch one piece of studio equipment per person.

examples.text: 桌上有两台笔记本电脑。
examples.trans: There are two laptops on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Pairs with 往 or 边: 往右 ('to the right'), 右边 ('the right side'); opposite of 左.

examples.text: 往右用力转一下……开了！
examples.trans: One firm turn to the right... and it's open!

examples.text: 过了桥往右走。
examples.trans: After the bridge, go right.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ba. At the end of a sentence, softens commands into friendly suggestions ('let's…') or asks for confirmation.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng. Focuses on the act of listening; add 见 or 到 (听见, 听到) for actually hearing.

examples.text: 老陈，你听到了吗？有人按了大门门铃！
examples.trans: Chen, did you hear that? Someone rang the front gate bell!

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

meanings.en: have a listen; listen a bit
meanings.note: Pinyin: tīng ting. Reduplicated verb making an invitation to listen warm and unhurried.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

examples.text: 听听保养大师说的！昨天修热水器，今天修两兄弟！
examples.trans: Listen to the maintenance master! Yesterday fixing the boiler, today fixing two brothers!

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé xián. Combines 和 ('harmonious/together') + 弦 ('musical string'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 最后一个温柔的和弦，高一个八度——又回家了。
examples.trans: And there is our gentle final chord, one octave higher—home again.

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上轻轻弹下第一个温暖的大调和弦。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently played the first warm major chord on the piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hǎn. Used for calling out to someone across a courtyard or street.

examples.text: 我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
examples.trans: All the way out in the courtyard I heard you shouting about butter.

examples.text: 有人在大门口喊你的名字。
examples.trans: Someone is calling your name at the front gate.

examples.text: 我还约了人，你们先回去吧。
examples.trans: I also have an appointment with someone; you two head back first.

examples.text: 这是回去。
examples.trans: This is 回去.

圆润.gloss: mellow and round (of tone or shape)

meanings.en: mellow and round (of tone or shape)
meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán rùn. Combines 圆 ('round/full') + 润 ('smooth/mellow/moist'), used for resonant musical tone, singing voices, or polished jade and wood.

examples.text: 修好后的中央瑞音既清亮又圆润，一点杂音都没有。
examples.trans: After the repair, middle D sounds both clear and mellow, without a trace of buzz.

examples.text: 这把旧小提琴的音色非常圆润，最适合拉抒情的圆舞曲。
examples.trans: This old violin has a wonderfully mellow tone, ideal for playing lyrical waltzes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuán wǔ qǔ. Compound from 圆 ('circle') + 舞 ('dance') + 曲 ('musical piece'). Measure word: 首 (shǒu).

examples.text: 宋老师在钢琴上弹了一首轻快的圆舞曲。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played a lively waltz on the piano.

examples.text: 这首老圆舞曲让人想起三十年前的晚茶会。
examples.trans: This old waltz brings back memories of evening tea gatherings thirty years ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēng yīn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个声音 ('a voice / sound').

examples.text: 声音客气吗？年轻人还是老人？
examples.trans: Was the voice polite? A young person or an older person?

examples.text: 声音轻，很有礼貌，大概三十多岁，有点紧张。
examples.trans: Soft-spoken, very polite, around thirty-something, and a bit nervous.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gū gu. Specifically father's sister (second syllable neutral tone); distinct from 阿姨 / 姨妈 (mother's sister).

examples.text: 周经理的姑姑以前也住在这座老院子里。
examples.trans: Manager Zhou's paternal aunt used to live in this old courtyard too.

examples.text: 我姑姑年轻的时候最喜欢弹钢琴。
examples.trans: When my aunt was young, she loved playing the piano most of all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ān jìng. Core A1 adjective for quiet courtyards and rooms.

examples.text: 很安静，谢谢，不过这个行李箱今天特别重。
examples.trans: Very quiet, thank you, though this suitcase feels especially heavy today.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán. Most often follows an action verb as a result complement meaning 'finish doing' (读完, 弹完).

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.en: feel free to; go right ahead
meanings.note: Pinyin: jín guǎn. Warm host adverb inviting someone not to hesitate (尽管说 'feel free to ask').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 不够喝的话，请尽管叫我添热茶。
examples.trans: If you want a refill, feel free to ask me for more hot tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gàn. Read gàn when meaning 'do work / get a job done' (干得不错 'nicely done!').

examples.text: 第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
examples.trans: For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.

examples.text: 不许盯着客人看。把箱子交还，干自己的活。
examples.trans: No staring at guests. Hand back the bag and do our own work.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nián. Time classifier taking no 个 directly after numbers (六年 'six years', 今年 'this year').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 老橡木，八十年了，一滴水都不漏。
examples.trans: Old oak, eighty years old—not a single drop leaks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tán. Used for playing the piano or guitar (弹钢琴 'play the piano').

examples.text: 那里住着一位老木匠和两个孙子——哥哥弹钢琴，弟弟最爱小火车！
examples.trans: An old carpenter lived there with two grandsons—the older brother played piano, and the younger loved toy trains!

examples.text: 哥哥性格爽朗声音大，弹音阶总是急匆匆的。
examples.trans: The older brother was bold and loud, always rushing through his scales.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎng. Guides movement in directions (往上提 'lift upward', 往左拐 'turn left').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Measure word (量词): 双 (shuāng), e.g. 一双手 ('a pair of hands').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 我手在发抖——车上下来穿深灰色外套的高个子男人吗？
examples.trans: My hands are shaking—is a tall man in a dark grey coat stepping out?

related.gloss: a pair of hands (measure word 双)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān shou. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把扳手 ('a wrench').

examples.text: 关掉了，水也放空了。把左边那把重扳手递给我。
examples.trans: Turned off and drained. Pass me that heavy wrench on your left.

examples.text: 这把大铁扳手吗？给你。
examples.trans: This big iron wrench? Here you go.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǎo huí. Compound 找 ('give change / look for') + 回 ('back'); used for coins/notes returned after paying cash.

examples.text: 我付了五十块现金，老板找回六个硬币。
examples.trans: I paid fifty yuan in cash and the vendor gave back six coins in change.

examples.text: 小晴在坐垫下面找回了丢失的铜钥匙。
examples.trans: Qing recovered the missing brass key from underneath the seat cushion.

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: níng. Used for twisting a tap, valve, wrench, or bottle cap (拧开 'twist open', 拧紧 'tighten').

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 把蓝色转轮慢慢往左拧开——别太快。
examples.trans: Turn the blue wheel open slowly to the left—not too fast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: àn. Used for pressing a doorbell, elevator button, or key (按门铃).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: cā. Used for wiping tables, drying water, or polishing lanterns.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 先生，给您干毛巾擦外套，还有一碗热汤。
examples.trans: Sir, here is a dry towel to wipe your coat, plus a bowl of hot soup.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhěng. Combines with a measure word to mean 'the entire' (整条街 'the whole street', 整栋楼 'the whole building').

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 今晚半价，而且一整周早餐免费！
examples.trans: Half price tonight, plus free breakfast all week!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xīn. Everyday adjective for new people, items, or beginnings.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 放心吧，周经理。房间干净，毛巾也是新的。
examples.trans: Relax, Manager Zhou. The room is clean, and the towels are fresh.

meanings.note: Pinyin: míng tiān. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 明天一天 ('all day tomorrow').

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 晚安，小晴。明天早餐见。
examples.trans: Good night, Qing. See you at breakfast tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì bú shì. A-not-A affirmative-negative question tag; bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 我们俩是不是刚升职当上正式试吃员了？
examples.trans: Did the two of us just get promoted to official taste testers?

examples.text: 你是不是把绿色登记本夹在胳膊底下了？
examples.trans: Didn't you tuck the green guest book under your arm?

meanings.note: Pinyin: mù tou. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块木头 ('a piece of wood').

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

examples.text: 怪不得这么重，全是木头和皮鞋！
examples.trans: No wonder it was so heavy—all wood and leather shoes!

related.gloss: a piece of wood (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zá yīn. Combines 杂 ('mixed/stray') + 音 ('sound'): mechanical buzz, rattle, or static interfering with pure musical tone.

examples.text: 老陈修好琴槌以后，中央瑞音一点儿杂音都没有了。
examples.trans: After Chen repaired the piano hammer, middle D had not the slightest squeak or buzz.

examples.text: 关上朝马路的那扇小窗，屋里就听不见外面的杂音了。
examples.trans: Close that small window facing the main road and you won't hear any stray noise inside.

架.gloss: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines

meanings.en: measure word for pianos, planes, framed machines
meanings.note: Pinyin: jià. Counts pianos, airplanes, and framed instruments (一架钢琴 'a piano').

examples.text: 三年前爷爷去世以后，我和志鹏因为卖老房子大吵了一架。
examples.trans: Three years ago after Grandfather passed away, Zhipeng and I argued bitterly over selling the old house.

examples.text: 客厅角落里放着一架老钢琴。
examples.trans: An old piano stands in the corner of the living room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé tao mù. Rich dark hardwood prized for upright pianos and classic furniture (note neutral-tone tao).

examples.text: 擦干净以后，老钢琴的核桃木外壳亮极了。
examples.trans: After being wiped clean, the old piano's walnut wood case gleams.

examples.text: 这张核桃木书桌已经在房间里放了四十年。
examples.trans: This walnut desk has stood in the room for forty years.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǐ. Forms comparisons in A 比 B + adj ('A is more adj than B').

examples.text: 说实话，我比以前灰色办公室喜欢这儿多了。
examples.trans: Honestly, I like this place far better than my old grey office.

examples.text: 听听他说的！老陈比我们好奇两倍！
examples.trans: Listen to him! Chen is twice as curious as we are!

meanings.note: Pinyin: máo zhān. Combines 毛 ('wool/hair') + 毡 ('pressed felt'), used inside piano actions for dampers, bushings, and hammers.

examples.text: 三十年前潮湿的空气只是让小小的毛毡轴套变松了。
examples.trans: The damp air thirty years ago merely loosened the tiny felt bushing.

examples.text: 椅子脚底下贴了毛毡垫，挪动时一点声音也没有。
examples.trans: Felt pads are stuck under the chair legs so they make no sound when moved.

meanings.en: not have; there is not; did not
meanings.note: Pinyin: méi yǒu. Negates 有 ('have / there is') and past actions.

examples.text: 可惜没有电话号码，只有两个字母和老街名字。
examples.trans: Unfortunately there is no phone number, only two letters and an old street name.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng liàng. Combines 清 ('clear/pure') + 亮 ('bright/resonant'), describing bell-like piano notes, singing voices, or clear eyes.

examples.text: 听这颗中央瑞音，既清亮又圆润，木头里一点杂音都没有！
examples.trans: Listen to this middle D—clear and mellow, with zero rattle in the wood!

examples.text: 清晨的院子里传来了清亮的鸟鸣声。
examples.trans: Clear, ringing birdsong echoed through the morning courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wēn nuǎn. Warmer and more emotional than plain 暖; used for sunshine, sound, and kindness.

examples.text: 听……有点低，很温暖，等等——中间这个琴键没有声音！
examples.trans: Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait—this middle key makes no sound!

examples.text: 谢谢你，你的话让我很温暖。
examples.trans: Thank you, your words make me feel warm inside.

meanings.note: Pinyin: líng. Describes acute senses (耳朵真灵 'what a keen ear!'), nimble hands, or a quick mind.

examples.text: 宋老师夸赞道：“老陈，您的耳朵真灵！一下就听出高音弦低了一点点。”
examples.trans: Teacher Song praised him: 'Chen, your ears are so keen! You heard right away that the treble string was a hair flat.'

examples.text: 虽然老陈上了年纪，修起精细的钟表和钢琴来手脚还是特别灵。
examples.trans: Even though Chen is getting on in years, his hands are still remarkably nimble when repairing watches and pianos.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bō li. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块玻璃 ('a pane of glass').

examples.text: 小晴，隔着玻璃看——他们俩在树下面对面站着呢！
examples.trans: Qing, look through the glass—the two of them are standing face to face under the tree!

examples.text: 擦干净玻璃窗以后，屋里亮多了。
examples.trans: After wiping the glass window clean, the room is much brighter.

related.gloss: a pane of glass (measure word 块)

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín xiāng. Combines 琴 ('piano/stringed instrument') + 箱 ('wooden case/resonating cabinet'); measure word: 台 (tái) or 个 (gè).

examples.text: 瞧瞧——这台老核桃木琴箱发出的共鸣把整间玻璃房都装满了！
examples.trans: Look at that—the resonance from this old walnut piano case fills the entire glass sunroom!

examples.text: 老陈用软棉布把核桃木琴箱擦拭得温润发亮。
examples.trans: Chen wiped the walnut piano case with a soft cotton cloth until it glowed warmly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qín jiàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个琴键 ('a piano key').

examples.text: 小晴，你看这些白琴键，又干净又完整。
examples.trans: Qing, look at these white keys—clean and whole.

examples.text: 听……有点低，很温暖，等等——中间这个琴键没有声音！
examples.trans: Listen... a little low, very warm, and wait—this middle key makes no sound!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ruì yīn. Combines Chinese solfège 瑞 (ruì, 'Re / D') + 音 ('musical note').

examples.text: 第二十八小节的旋律正好稳稳落在中央瑞音上！
examples.trans: The melody in bar twenty-eight lands squarely on middle D!

examples.text: 修好轴销以后，中央瑞音终于重新发出了清脆的声音。
examples.trans: Once the hinge pin was fixed, middle D finally rang out clearly again.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòng. Works as main verb ('use a key') or preposition ('with/using').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhēn. Exclamatory adverb before adjectives (真好！ 'How nice!') or adjective 'genuine'.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhe. Placed right after a verb to show a state or posture continues (门开着 'the door stands open').

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 白纸包着什么？一个木头小火车！
examples.trans: What is wrapped in white paper? A little wooden train!

瞧瞧.gloss: take a look; look at that

meanings.en: take a look; look at that
meanings.note: Pinyin: qiáo qiao. Reduplication of colloquial northern/standard verb 瞧 ('look/see'); second syllable is neutral tone.

examples.text: 瞧瞧——这台老核桃木琴箱的琴声把整间玻璃房都装满了！
examples.trans: Just look at that—the sound from this old walnut piano fills the entire glass room!

examples.text: 快过来瞧瞧老陈刚挂好的四扇绿窗板，多精神呀！
examples.trans: Come take a look at the four green shutters Chen just hung—how sharp they look!

examples.text: 老师，我稍微感觉有点失望。
examples.trans: Professor, I feel slightly disappointed.

examples.text: 这是稍微。
examples.trans: This is 稍微.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wěn. Describes holding something steadily or playing music evenly.

examples.text: 手电筒拿稳，照着这儿的水管接口。
examples.trans: Hold the flashlight steady and shine it on the pipe joint here.

examples.text: 拿稳了！你已经关掉总水阀了吗？
examples.trans: Steady! Did you turn off the main water valve already?

meanings.note: Verb-complement wěnzhù ('hold someone steady, keep talking').

examples.text: 你先稳住许天泽，让我想想办法。
examples.trans: Keep Xu Tianze steady first while I think of a plan.

examples.text: 越是关键时刻，主持人越要稳住全场。
examples.trans: At crucial moments, a host must steady the whole room.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng. Everyday verb for waiting (等一下 'wait a moment').

examples.text: 等一下，咖啡厅的小美正朝我招手呢！
examples.trans: Wait a moment—Mei in the café is waving toward me right now!

examples.text: 等一下，小晴……你拿了哪一包黄油？
examples.trans: Wait a second, Qing... which packet of butter did you grab?

meanings.note: Pinyin: suǒ dà diào. Combines solfège note 索 ('Sol / G') + 大调 ('major key'): G major.

examples.text: 宋老师从容地按下了琴键，弹出一串明亮温暖的索大调和弦。
examples.trans: Teacher Song calmly pressed the keys, playing a bright, warm G-major chord.

examples.text: 周经理姑姑写的那首《小院圆舞曲》正是用欢快的索大调写成的。
examples.trans: The 'Courtyard Waltz' written by Manager Zhou's aunt was composed in bright G major.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jǐn. Describes tightening a valve (拧紧) or a tight schedule.

examples.text: 当心那把角落椅子，等十秒我拧紧螺丝。
examples.trans: Mind that corner chair—wait ten seconds while I tighten the screw.

examples.text: 小晴，把床单角塞紧！放上两个软枕头。
examples.trans: Qing, tuck the sheet corner tight! On go the two soft pillows.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng yú. Expresses relief or accomplishment when something long awaited happens.

examples.text: 把大难题分成三件小事，周经理终于能松口气了！
examples.trans: With the big problem divided into three small jobs, Manager Zhou could finally breathe again!

examples.text: 锁了三十年的木头窗板今天终于重新打开了。
examples.trans: The wooden shutters locked for thirty years finally swung open again today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǎo. Describes longtime friends, historic lanes, or warm respect before a colleague's surname (老陈).

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

meanings.note: Pinyin: ěr duo. Combines 耳 ('ear') + suffix 朵 (neutral tone); measure word: 只 (zhī, single) or 双 (shuāng, pair).

examples.text: 宋老师称赞道：“老陈，您的耳朵真灵，连一丝丝音差都能听出来！”
examples.trans: Teacher Song praised him: 'Chen, you have such a keen ear—you can hear even the tiniest fraction of pitch difference!'

examples.text: 听见美妙的钢琴声，连院子里的客人都竖起了耳朵。
examples.trans: Hearing the lovely piano music, even the guests in the courtyard perked up their ears.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zì jǐ. Follows pronouns to stress 'by oneself' (你自己 'you yourself').

examples.text: 所以老房子自己会打招呼？
examples.trans: So the old house says hello by itself?

examples.text: 那个人为什么不拿回自己的箱子就跑了？
examples.trans: Why did that person run off without taking his own suitcase back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng. Used for packing items into a bag/box (装进) or fitting hardware.

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhuāng mǎn. Resultative verb compound 装 ('fill/load/hold') + 满 ('full').

examples.text: 这台老核桃木琴箱发出的温暖琴声，把整间玻璃房都装满了！
examples.trans: The warm sound from this old walnut piano case filled the entire glass room!

examples.text: 周经理睡觉以前把小美那两个大白瓷罐都装满了。
examples.trans: Before going to bed, Manager Zhou filled both of Mei's big white ceramic jars to the brim.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì shi. Warm, low-pressure invitation to try something.

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

examples.text: 这把备用钥匙能不能开，插进去试试就知道了。
examples.trans: Slip this spare key in and try it to see if it unlocks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tiáo yīn. Separable verb-object compound 调 (tiáo, 2nd tone 'adjust/harmonize') + 音 ('pitch/tone').

examples.text: 等老陈修好那根琴槌，宋老师就能给钢琴调音了。
examples.trans: Once Chen fixes that piano hammer, Teacher Song will be able to tune the piano.

examples.text: 音乐会开始前，调音师花了一个小时给钢琴仔细调音。
examples.trans: Before the concert began, the technician spent an hour carefully tuning the piano.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè xie. Standard expression of gratitude; takes an optional person after it (谢谢您).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐ lái. Marks standing up or beginning/evaluating an action.

examples.text: 摸摸铜管！已经热起来了！
examples.trans: Touch the copper pipe! It is warming up already!

examples.text: 快把那张纸折起来，塞进口袋里。
examples.trans: Fold up that sheet of paper right now and tuck it into your pocket.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gēn. As a verb, 'follow' (跟我来 'follow me'); as a preposition, 'with' (跟你一样 'same as yours').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

踏板.gloss: pedal (of a piano or bicycle); footboard

meanings.en: pedal (of a piano or bicycle); footboard
meanings.note: Pinyin: tà bǎn. Combines 踏 ('step on/tread') + 板 ('board/plate'); measure word: 个 (gè) or 根 (gēn); verb: 踩 (cǎi).

examples.text: 连钢琴底下的黄铜延音踏板，老陈都擦得像黄金一样亮！
examples.trans: Chen even polished the brass sustain pedal beneath the piano until it shone like gold!

examples.text: 宋老师轻轻踩下右边的踏板，让最后一个和弦在阳光房里久久回响。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently pressed the right pedal, letting the final chord linger softly in the sunroom.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhóu tào. Combines 轴 ('pivot pin/axle') + 套 ('lining sleeve'): in a piano action, the tiny cloth/felt ring lining a pin hole.

examples.text: 潮湿空气让细小的毛毡轴套松了，所以轴销才会滑出来。
examples.trans: Damp air loosened the tiny felt bushing, which let the hinge pin slip out.

examples.text: 换上紧实的毛毡轴套以后，琴槌就不再左右摇晃了。
examples.trans: Once fitted with a snug felt bushing, the piano hammer no longer wobbles sideways.

轴销.gloss: hinge pin; center pin (in piano action)

meanings.en: hinge pin; center pin (in piano action)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zhóu xiāo. Combines 轴 ('pivot') + 销 ('metal pin/peg'): the tiny brass center pin on which a piano hammer pivots.

examples.text: 把手电筒照近一点，就能看见那根黄铜轴销滑出来一半。
examples.trans: Shine the light closer and you can see that brass hinge pin slipped halfway out.

examples.text: 老陈用细镊子夹住黄铜轴销，稳稳地推回了原位。
examples.trans: Chen gripped the brass pin with fine tweezers and seated it steadily back in place.

meanings.note: Pinyin: qīng qīng. Reduplication of 轻 ('light/soft'), used directly before short verbs or with 地 (轻轻地抽出来).

examples.text: 宋老师用两根手指把旧乐谱轻轻抽了出来。
examples.trans: Teacher Song gently slid the old music sheet out with two fingers.

examples.text: 怕吵醒午睡的客人，小晴轻轻关上了木门。
examples.trans: So as not to wake guests napping at noon, Qing closed the wooden door softly.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhè. Proximal demonstrative; pairs with a measure word before nouns (这个 'this one', 这间房 'this room').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhèr. Spoken variant of 这里 ('here').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 没错！你已经很习惯这儿了。
examples.trans: Exactly! You already fit right in here.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nà. Distal demonstrative before measure words (那个 'that one'); at clause start, means 'then / well then'.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng biǎo jiàng. Combines 钟表 ('clocks and watches') + craftsperson suffix 匠 ('artisan/master craftsperson'); measure word: 位 (wèi).

examples.text: 宋老师敬佩地说：“老陈，您的手像钟表匠一样稳！”
examples.trans: Teacher Song said admiringly, 'Chen, your hands are as steady as a watchmaker's!'

examples.text: 一位经验丰富的老钟表匠能听出齿轮里最细微的声音。
examples.trans: An experienced master watchmaker can hear the faintest sound inside the gears.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng. Hard carbon-iron alloy used for tools and piano strings (钢调音扳手 'steel tuning wrench', 钢丝 'steel wire').

examples.text: 老陈拿起结实的钢调音扳手，往右轻轻拧了一丝丝。
examples.trans: Chen picked up the sturdy steel tuning wrench and turned it a tiny fraction to the right.

examples.text: 厨房里那把切胡萝卜丁的厨师刀是用好钢打造的。
examples.trans: The chef's knife used for dicing carrots in the kitchen is forged from fine steel.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng qín. Measure word (量词): 架 (jià), e.g. 一架钢琴 ('a piano').

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiān. Counts rooms of all kinds: bedrooms, guest rooms, studies, kitchens (一间客房 'a guest room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那间向阳的旧阁楼书房……快跟我来！
examples.trans: That sunny old attic study... follow me, quickly!

meanings.note: Pinyin: miàn bǎn. Compound 面 ('surface/face') + 板 ('plate/board'): flat cover plate of a wall switch or control panel.

examples.text: 铜开关面板用两颗小螺丝紧紧固定在砖墙上。
examples.trans: The brass switch faceplate is fastened tightly against the brick wall with two small screws.

examples.text: 装好灯以后，老陈用干布擦亮了开关面板。
examples.trans: After installing the lamp, Chen polished the switch plate bright with a dry cloth.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yīn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个音 ('a musical note').

examples.text: 当然记得！每到星期五弹错一个音，他就对着墙皱眉头。
examples.trans: Of course I remember! Every Friday when he missed a note, he frowned at the wall.

examples.text: 这架老钢琴每个音都很准。
examples.trans: Every note on this old piano is right in tune.

首.gloss: measure word for songs and poems

meanings.en: measure word for songs and poems
meanings.note: Pinyin: shǒu. Counts songs, poems, and pieces of music (一首歌 'a song').

examples.text: 老陈，好好修一次老钢琴，它会记得每一首歌。
examples.trans: Chen, repair an old piano properly once, and it will remember every song.

examples.text: 宋老师给我们弹了一首老歌。
examples.trans: Teacher Song played an old song for us.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huáng tóng. Literally 黄 ('yellow/golden') + 铜 ('copper/bronze'): copper-zinc brass alloy.

examples.text: 钢琴琴槌里面的细小轴销是用结实的黄铜做的。
examples.trans: The tiny hinge pins inside piano hammers are made of sturdy brass.

examples.text: 老陈把前台的黄铜小铃铛擦得金光发亮。
examples.trans: Chen polished the little brass bell on the front desk until it gleamed.
